mechanism: Diltiazem may inhibit valproate metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, potentially increasing valproate levels, while valproate may displace diltiazem from protein binding and affect cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor valproate and diltiazem levels; watch for signs of valproate toxicity (tremor, ataxia, lethargy) and cardiac effects (bradycardia, AV block); consider dose adjustments if levels become elevated.
